title: Rejected local GCP ciphertext is forwarded upstream after decrypt failure
description: Security review of gateway runtime replay persistence: dispatch_runtime_gcp returns false when a structurally valid, peer-context-selected OSCORE datagram fails unprotect (including an in-memory replay after a persistence failure). ingest_mesh_frame_at_superframe interprets false as non-GCP and forwards the original encrypted IPv6 packet upstream, turning rejected local control traffic into an unintended forwarding path. Once a packet selects an installed local GCP context, consume/drop all authentication/decryption failures; return non-GCP only after successful decryption proves a different resource path. Add a regression assertion.
